verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: צַ֚ו אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וִֽישַׁלְּחוּ֙ מִן־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה כָּל־ צָר֖וּעַ וְכָל־ זָ֑ב וְכֹ֖ל טָמֵ֥א לָנָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣaw ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wî·šal·lə·ḥū min- ham·ma·ḥă·neh kāl- ṣā·rū·a‘ wə·ḵāl zāḇ wə·ḵōl ṭā·mê lā·nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: Command the Israelites . . . to send away from the camp anyone with a skin disease anyone who has a bodily discharge and anyone who is defiled by a dead body

verses.original: מִזָּכָ֤ר עַד־ נְקֵבָה֙ תְּשַׁלֵּ֔חוּ אֶל־ מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה תְּשַׁלְּח֑וּם וְלֹ֤א יְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת־ מַ֣חֲנֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֥ן בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: miz·zā·ḵār ‘aḏ- nə·qê·ḇāh tə·šal·lê·ḥū ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh tə·šal·lə·ḥūm wə·lō yə·ṭam·mə·’ū ’eṯ- ma·ḥă·nê·hem ’ă·šer ’ă·nî šō·ḵên bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: You must send away . . . male and female alike send them outside the camp so they will not defile their camp where I dwell among them

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ כֵן֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיְשַׁלְּח֣וּ אוֹתָ֔ם אֶל־ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·šal·lə·ḥū ’ō·w·ṯām ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh kên ‘ā·śū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So the Israelites . . . did this sending such people outside the camp They . . . did just as the LORD . . . had instructed Moses . . .

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ אִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־ אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּ֤י יַעֲשׂוּ֙ מִכָּל־ חַטֹּ֣את הָֽאָדָ֔ם לִמְעֹ֥ל מַ֖עַל בַּיהוָ֑ה וְאָֽשְׁמָ֖ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִֽוא׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’îš ’ōw- ’iš·šāh kî ya·‘ă·śū mik·kāl ḥaṭ·ṭōṯ hā·’ā·ḏām lim·‘ōl ma·‘al Yah·weh wə·’ā·šə·māh han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w
verses.literal: Tell . . . the Israelites that . . . when a man or woman acts unfaithfully against the LORD by committing any sin against another that person is guilty

verses.original: וְהִתְוַדּ֗וּ אֶֽת־ חַטָּאתָם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂוּ֒ וְהֵשִׁ֤יב אֶת־ אֲשָׁמוֹ֙ בְּרֹאשׁ֔וֹ וַחֲמִישִׁת֖וֹ יֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֑יו וְנָתַ֕ן לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָשַׁ֥ם לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṯ·wad·dū ’eṯ- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū wə·hê·šîḇ ’eṯ- ’ă·šā·mōw bə·rō·šōw wa·ḥă·mî·ši·ṯōw yō·sêp̄ ‘ā·lāw wə·nā·ṯan la·’ă·šer ’ā·šam lōw
verses.literal: and must confess the sin he has committed He must make full restitution - . . . add a fifth to its value and give all this to the one he has wronged

verses.original: וְאִם־ אֵ֨ין לָאִ֜ישׁ גֹּאֵ֗ל לְהָשִׁ֤יב הָאָשָׁם֙ אֵלָ֔יו הָאָשָׁ֛ם הַמּוּשָׁ֥ב לַיהוָ֖ה לַכֹּהֵ֑ן מִלְּבַ֗ד אֵ֚יל הַכִּפֻּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְכַפֶּר־ בּ֖וֹ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’ên lā·’îš gō·’êl lə·hā·šîḇ hā·’ā·šām ’ê·lāw hā·’ā·šām ham·mū·šāḇ Yah·weh lak·kō·hên mil·lə·ḇaḏ ’êl hak·kip·pu·rîm ’ă·šer yə·ḵap·per- bōw ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: But if the man has no relative to whom restitution can be made for the wrong . . . the restitution belongs to the LORD and must be given to the priest along with the ram of atonement by which the atonement is made for him

verses.original: וְכָל־ תְּרוּמָ֞ה לְכָל־ קָדְשֵׁ֧י בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יַקְרִ֥יבוּ לַכֹּהֵ֖ן ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl tə·rū·māh lə·ḵāl qā·ḏə·šê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- yaq·rî·ḇū lak·kō·hên lōw yih·yeh
verses.literal: Every sacred contribution . . . the Israelites . . . bring to the priest shall belong to him

verses.original: וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ קֳדָשָׁ֖יו ל֣וֹ יִהְי֑וּ אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִתֵּ֥ן לַכֹּהֵ֖ן ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’eṯ- qo·ḏā·šāw lōw yih·yū ’îš ’ă·šer- yit·tên lak·kō·hên lōw yih·yeh
verses.literal: Each man’s sacred gifts are his own but whatever he gives to the priest will belong to the priest

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ כִּֽי־ תִשְׂטֶ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וּמָעֲלָ֥ה ב֖וֹ מָֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’îš ’îš kî- ṯiś·ṭeh ’iš·tōw ū·mā·‘ă·lāh ḇōw mā·‘al
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them that . . . if any man’s . . . wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him

verses.original: וְשָׁכַ֨ב אִ֣ישׁ אֹתָהּ֮ שִׁכְבַת־ זֶרַע֒ וְנֶעְלַם֙ מֵעֵינֵ֣י אִישָׁ֔הּ וְנִסְתְּרָ֖ה וְהִ֣יא נִטְמָ֑אָה וְעֵד֙ אֵ֣ין בָּ֔הּ וְהִ֖וא לֹ֥א נִתְפָּֽשָׂה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḵaḇ ’îš ’ō·ṯāh šiḵ·ḇaṯ- ze·ra‘ wə·ne‘·lam mê·‘ê·nê ’î·šāh wə·nis·tə·rāh wə·hî niṭ·mā·’āh wə·‘êḏ ’ên bāh wə·hi·w lō niṯ·pā·śāh
verses.literal: by sleeping with another man . . . . . . . . . and it is concealed from her husband and her impurity is undetected since there is no witness against her and she was not caught in the act

verses.original: וְעָבַ֨ר עָלָ֧יו רֽוּחַ־ קִנְאָ֛ה וְקִנֵּ֥א אֶת־ אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ וְהִ֣וא נִטְמָ֑אָה אוֹ־ עָבַ֨ר עָלָ֤יו רֽוּחַ־ קִנְאָה֙ וְקִנֵּ֣א אֶת־ אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וְהִ֖יא לֹ֥א נִטְמָֽאָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇar ‘ā·lāw rū·aḥ- qin·’āh wə·qin·nê ’eṯ- ’iš·tōw wə·hi·w niṭ·mā·’āh ’ōw- ‘ā·ḇar ‘ā·lāw rū·aḥ- qin·’āh wə·qin·nê ’eṯ- ’iš·tōw wə·hî lō niṭ·mā·’āh
verses.literal: and if a feeling of jealousy comes over her husband and he suspects his wife who has defiled herself or if a feeling of jealousy comes over him and he suspects her even though she has not defiled herself

verses.original: וְהֵבִ֨יא הָאִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ אִשְׁתּוֹ֮ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְהֵבִ֤יא אֶת־ קָרְבָּנָהּ֙ עָלֶ֔יהָ עֲשִׂירִ֥ת הָאֵיפָ֖ה קֶ֣מַח שְׂעֹרִ֑ים לֹֽא־ יִצֹ֨ק עָלָ֜יו שֶׁ֗מֶן וְלֹֽא־ יִתֵּ֤ן עָלָיו֙ לְבֹנָ֔ה כִּֽי־ מִנְחַ֤ת קְנָאֹת֙ ה֔וּא מִנְחַ֥ת זִכָּר֖וֹן מַזְכֶּ֥רֶת עָוֺֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇî hā·’îš ’eṯ- ’iš·tōw ’el- hak·kō·hên wə·hê·ḇî ’eṯ- qā·rə·bā·nāh ‘ā·le·hā ‘ă·śî·riṯ hā·’ê·p̄āh qe·maḥ śə·‘ō·rîm lō- yi·ṣōq ‘ā·lāw še·men wə·lō- yit·tên ‘ā·lāw lə·ḇō·nāh kî- min·ḥaṯ qə·nā·’ōṯ hū min·ḥaṯ zik·kā·rō·wn maz·ke·reṯ ‘ā·wōn
verses.literal: then he is to bring his wife to the priest He must also bring for her an offering of a tenth of an ephah of barley flour He is not to pour oil . . . over it or put frankincense on it because it is a grain offering for jealousy an offering of memorial as a reminder of iniquity

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖הּ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְהֶֽעֱמִדָ֖הּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rîḇ ’ō·ṯāh hak·kō·hên wə·he·‘ĕ·mi·ḏāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: The priest is to bring the wife forward and have her stand before the LORD

verses.original: וְלָקַ֧ח הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מַ֥יִם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים בִּכְלִי־ חָ֑רֶשׂ וּמִן־ הֶֽעָפָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִהְיֶה֙ בְּקַרְקַ֣ע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יִקַּ֥ח הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְנָתַ֥ן אֶל־ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên ma·yim qə·ḏō·šîm biḵ·lî- ḥā·reś ū·min- he·‘ā·p̄ār ’ă·šer yih·yeh bə·qar·qa‘ ham·miš·kān yiq·qaḥ hak·kō·hên wə·nā·ṯan ’el- ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: Then he is to take some holy water in a clay jar - and put some of the dust - from the tabernacle floor into the water

verses.original: וְהֶעֱמִ֨יד הַכֹּהֵ֥ן אֶֽת־ הָאִשָּׁה֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ וּפָרַע֙ אֶת־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וְנָתַ֣ן עַל־ כַּפֶּ֗יהָ אֵ֚ת מִנְחַ֣ת הַזִּכָּר֔וֹן מִנְחַ֥ת קְנָאֹ֖ת הִ֑וא וּבְיַ֤ד הַכֹּהֵן֙ יִהְי֔וּ מֵ֥י הַמָּרִ֖ים הַמְאָֽרֲרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ĕ·mîḏ hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- hā·’iš·šāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh ū·p̄ā·ra‘ ’eṯ- rōš hā·’iš·šāh wə·nā·ṯan ‘al- kap·pe·hā ’êṯ min·ḥaṯ haz·zik·kā·rō·wn min·ḥaṯ qə·nā·’ōṯ hî ū·ḇə·yaḏ hak·kō·hên yih·yū mê ham·mā·rîm ham·’ā·ră·rîm
verses.literal: After the priest has the woman stand before the LORD he is to let down her hair and place in her hands the grain offering of memorial which is the grain offering for jealousy The priest is to hold the bitter water that brings a curse

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבִּ֨יעַ אֹתָ֜הּ הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְאָמַ֤ר אֶל־ הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אִם־ לֹ֨א שָׁכַ֥ב אִישׁ֙ אֹתָ֔ךְ וְאִם־ לֹ֥א שָׂטִ֛ית טֻמְאָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת אִישֵׁ֑ךְ הִנָּקִ֕י מִמֵּ֛י הַמָּרִ֥ים הַֽמְאָרֲרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·bî·a‘ ’ō·ṯāh hak·kō·hên wə·’ā·mar ’el- hā·’iš·šāh ’im- lō šā·ḵaḇ ’îš ’ō·ṯāḵ wə·’im- lō śā·ṭîṯ ṭum·’āh ta·ḥaṯ ’î·šêḵ hin·nā·qî mim·mê ham·mā·rîm ham·’ā·ră·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: And he is to put the woman under oath and say to her If no other man . . . has slept with you and you have not gone astray and become defiled while under your husband’s authority may you be immune to this bitter water that brings a curse

verses.original: וְאַ֗תְּ כִּ֥י שָׂטִ֛ית תַּ֥חַת אִישֵׁ֖ךְ וְכִ֣י נִטְמֵ֑את וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אִ֥ישׁ בָּךְ֙ אֶת־ שְׁכָבְתּ֔וֹ מִֽבַּלְעֲדֵ֖י אִישֵֽׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at kî śā·ṭîṯ ta·ḥaṯ ’î·šêḵ wə·ḵî niṭ·mêṯ way·yit·tên ’îš bāḵ ’eṯ- šə·ḵā·ḇə·tōw mib·bal·‘ă·ḏê ’î·šêḵ
verses.literal: But if you have gone astray while under your husband’s authority and have defiled yourself and lain carnally with a man other than your husband

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבִּ֨יעַ הַכֹּהֵ֥ן אֶֽת־ הָֽאִשָּׁה֮ בִּשְׁבֻעַ֣ת הָאָלָה֒ וְאָמַ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ לָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה יִתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה אוֹתָ֛ךְ לְאָלָ֥ה וְלִשְׁבֻעָ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ עַמֵּ֑ךְ בְּתֵ֨ת יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ יְרֵכֵךְ֙ נֹפֶ֔לֶת וְאֶת־ בִּטְנֵ֖ךְ צָבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·bî·a‘ hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- hā·’iš·šāh biš·ḇu·‘aṯ hā·’ā·lāh wə·’ā·mar hak·kō·hên lā·’iš·šāh yit·tên Yah·weh ’ō·w·ṯāḵ lə·’ā·lāh wə·liš·ḇu·‘āh bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘am·mêḵ bə·ṯêṯ Yah·weh ’eṯ- yə·rê·ḵêḵ nō·p̄e·leṯ wə·’eṯ- biṭ·nêḵ ṣā·ḇāh
verses.literal: and the priest shall have the woman swear under the oath of the curse - then may the LORD make you an attested curse among your people by making your thigh shrivel and your belly swell

verses.original: וּ֠בָאוּ הַמַּ֨יִם הַמְאָרְרִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ בְּֽמֵעַ֔יִךְ לַצְבּ֥וֹת בֶּ֖טֶן וְלַנְפִּ֣ל יָרֵ֑ךְ וְאָמְרָ֥ה הָאִשָּׁ֖ה אָמֵ֥ן׀ אָמֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·’ū ham·ma·yim ham·’ā·rə·rîm hā·’êl·leh bə·mê·‘a·yiḵ laṣ·bō·wṯ be·ṭen wə·lan·pil yā·rêḵ wə·’ā·mə·rāh hā·’iš·šāh ’ā·mên ’ā·mên
verses.literal: May this water that brings a curse enter your stomach and cause your belly to swell and your thigh to shrivel Then the woman is to say Amen Amen

verses.original: וְ֠כָתַב אֶת־ הָאָלֹ֥ת הָאֵ֛לֶּה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בַּסֵּ֑פֶר וּמָחָ֖ה אֶל־ מֵ֥י הַמָּרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·ṯaḇ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·lōṯ hā·’êl·leh hak·kō·hên bas·sê·p̄er ū·mā·ḥāh ’el- mê ham·mā·rîm
verses.literal: And the priest shall write these curses on a scroll and wash them off into the bitter water

verses.original: וְהִשְׁקָה֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אִשָּׁ֔ה אֶת־ מֵ֥י הַמָּרִ֖ים הַמְאָֽרֲרִ֑ים וּבָ֥אוּ בָ֛הּ הַמַּ֥יִם הַֽמְאָרֲרִ֖ים לְמָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·qāh ’eṯ- hā·’iš·šāh ’eṯ- mê ham·mā·rîm ham·’ā·ră·rîm ū·ḇā·’ū ḇāh ham·ma·yim ham·’ā·ră·rîm lə·mā·rîm
verses.literal: He is to have the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse and it will enter her and may cause her bitter suffering

verses.original: וְלָקַ֤ח הַכֹּהֵן֙ מִיַּ֣ד הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה אֵ֖ת מִנְחַ֣ת הַקְּנָאֹ֑ת וְהֵנִ֤יף אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖הּ אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên mî·yaḏ hā·’iš·šāh ’êṯ min·ḥaṯ haq·qə·nā·’ōṯ wə·hê·nîp̄ ’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·hiq·rîḇ ’ō·ṯāh ’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: The priest shall take from her hand the grain offering for jealousy wave it before the LORD and bring it to the altar

verses.original: וְקָמַ֨ץ הַכֹּהֵ֤ן מִן־ הַמִּנְחָה֙ אֶת־ אַזְכָּ֣רָתָ֔הּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְאַחַ֛ר יַשְׁקֶ֥ה אֶת־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה אֶת־ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qā·maṣ hak·kō·hên min- ham·min·ḥāh ’eṯ- ’az·kā·rā·ṯāh wə·hiq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·ḥāh wə·’a·ḥar yaš·qeh ’eṯ- hā·’iš·šāh ’eṯ- ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: Then the priest is to take a handful of the grain offering as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar after that he is to have the woman drink the water

verses.original: וְהִשְׁקָ֣הּ אֶת־ הַמַּ֗יִם וְהָיְתָ֣ה אִֽם־ נִטְמְאָה֮ וַתִּמְעֹ֣ל מַ֣עַל בְּאִישָׁהּ֒ וּבָ֨אוּ בָ֜הּ הַמַּ֤יִם הַמְאָֽרֲרִים֙ לְמָרִ֔ים וְצָבְתָ֣ה בִטְנָ֔הּ וְנָפְלָ֖ה יְרֵכָ֑הּ וְהָיְתָ֧ה הָאִשָּׁ֛ה לְאָלָ֖ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·qāh ’eṯ- ham·ma·yim wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ’im- niṭ·mə·’āh wat·tim·‘ōl ma·‘al bə·’î·šāh ū·ḇā·’ū ḇāh ham·ma·yim ham·’ā·ră·rîm lə·mā·rîm wə·ṣā·ḇə·ṯāh ḇiṭ·nāh wə·nā·p̄ə·lāh yə·rê·ḵāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh hā·’iš·šāh lə·’ā·lāh bə·qe·reḇ ‘am·māh
verses.literal: When he has made her drink the water if she has defiled herself and been unfaithful . . . to her husband then the water that brings a curse will enter her and cause bitter suffering her belly will swell her thigh will shrivel and she will become . . . accursed among her people

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֤א נִטְמְאָה֙ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וּטְהֹרָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְנִקְּתָ֖ה וְנִזְרְעָ֥ה זָֽרַע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō niṭ·mə·’āh hā·’iš·šāh ū·ṭə·hō·rāh hî wə·niq·qə·ṯāh wə·niz·rə·‘āh zā·ra‘
verses.literal: But if the woman has not defiled herself and is clean she will be unaffected and able to conceive children

verses.original: זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַקְּנָאֹ֑ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׂטֶ֥ה אִשָּׁ֛ה תַּ֥חַת אִישָׁ֖הּ וְנִטְמָֽאָה׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ tō·w·raṯ haq·qə·nā·’ōṯ ’ă·šer tiś·ṭeh ’iš·šāh ta·ḥaṯ ’î·šāh wə·niṭ·mā·’āh
verses.literal: This is the law of jealousy when a wife goes astray and defiles herself while under her husband’s authority

verses.original: א֣וֹ אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תַּעֲבֹ֥ר עָלָ֛יו ר֥וּחַ קִנְאָ֖ה וְקִנֵּ֣א אֶת־ אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְהֶעֱמִ֤יד אֶת־ הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְעָ֤שָׂה לָהּ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַתּוֹרָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ’îš ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·ḇōr ‘ā·lāw rū·aḥ qin·’āh wə·qin·nê ’eṯ- ’iš·tōw wə·he·‘ĕ·mîḏ ’eṯ- hā·’iš·šāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·‘ā·śāh lāh hak·kō·hên ’êṯ kāl- hat·tō·w·rāh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: or when a feeling of jealousy comes over . . . a husband and he suspects his wife He is to have the woman stand before the LORD and the priest is to apply to her this entire law

verses.original: וְנִקָּ֥ה הָאִ֖ישׁ מֵעָוֺ֑ן וְהָאִשָּׁ֣ה הַהִ֔וא תִּשָּׂ֖א אֶת־ עֲוֺנָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·niq·qāh hā·’îš mê·‘ā·wōn wə·hā·’iš·šāh ha·hi·w tiś·śā ’eṯ- ‘ă·wō·nāh
verses.literal: The husband will be free from guilt but the woman shall bear her iniquity
